text:
Sympathetic innervation of the colon in this patient’s irritable bowel syndrome originates from preganglionic cell bodies in the intermediolateral column at about T10–L2, which travel in the lesser, least, and lumbar splanchnic nerves to the superior and inferior mesenteric ganglia. S2–S4 is parasympathetic pelvic splanchnic outflow to the distal colon, and L3–L5 is not the origin of these preganglionic sympathetic fibers.

CONFIDENCE: 90
